items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: Paul Quinichette and Wardell Gray Delagray together?

ctx.x: I would have any two tenor saxophone players, any two good tenors, if I could get them, you know.
Let me ask you this: would you possibly -- you couldn't possibly have Paul Quinichette and Wardell Gray Delagray together?
Oh, yeah. I don't know, I don't see why I couldn't, would you?
